APPROVE
The logic is moved into a private nested `Reader` class with the same branch order, the same state resets and the same `i + 1` line numbers, so `Read` drops to about 1 and every helper stays well under 15. The only spots that look different are equivalent: the comment check (`raw.Trim()` vs `raw.TrimStart()`) and the `IsDependencySection(_top)` substitution, assuming that helper's body (not visible in the diff, and I couldn't find the source) checks the same three names as the literal it replaces.
